# Sales Order Gaps

###### Contents
Scope 2
Purpose 2
Solution 2
Delivery Duplication 2
Revision Log 3
Confirmed * Functionality 6
Approver Name at Activity Timeline 6
Sales Order Print Screen Enhancement 6
Delivery/OC-level grouping 6
Quantity visibility 7

# Scope
• The system should prevent duplicate combinations of Delivery Order No, OC Delivery Date, Buyer Delivery, and Mode of Shipment — this needs a composite uniqueness check.
• Visible activity/audit log for quantity changes, price changes, or adding/deleting a delivery line. This is a traceability gap that could matter if a customer disputes a change later.
• The Sales Order(OC) with "Confirmed *" status will not be having delete button.
Selling Price should be handled through SLC.
• If OC is sent to approval then approver name not showing on OC activity timeline.
• Delivery/OC-level grouping: Group deliveries at the OC level and display the corresponding subtotal.
• Quantity visibility: Display the quantity, including the extra production %, in a separate grid.

# Purpose

# Solution

## Delivery Duplication
It should be restricted if Delivery Buyer Order Ref, Buyer Delivery Date, OC Delivery Date & Mode of Shipment are same, if any one of them changes then it will allow making Delivery.

## Revision Log
At grid level context menu at sales order list there is a tool name Revision Log, which is enabled only when a confirmed order is being revised. Revision Log will by default show the Latest revised version and that too modified tab.
Modified Tab:
Now when user clicks on Revision Log a page opens with latest version in modified tab.
Versions are controlled from header level by clicking on dropdown will show all the versions and multi select is also allowed.
Once the user selects the version it will load on the screen simultaneously on all tabs All, Modified & Inserted/Deleted.
Row names will be shown only when changes are done:
Version Change
Revision Authorised By
Reason for Revision
Delivery Name
Delivery Header Detail Changes
Total Qty & UOM
Total Value & Currency
Delivery Quantity Detail
Article
Color & Size
Qty & UOM
Price
Value & Currency
Inserted/Deleted tab:
Version and Deliveries will be left pinned.
Columns name – Version, Delivery Name, Status(Inserted/Deleted), Delivery Buyer Order Ref, Destination, Mode Of Shipment, Delivery Date, Total Qty & UOM(Have an hyperlink that show a pop -up at color/size breakdown of that delivery, it shows those colors and sizes that are been chooses at the time of sales order creation), Total Value & Currency, version Change, Revision Authorized By, Reason for Revision.
All tab:
Will show the consolidated view of insert and delete but in row wise format and row names will be as provided above for modified and inserted/delete tab

## Confirmed * Functionality
If a Sales Order is confirmed and then revised and a delivery is kept in draft then Delete button will be disabled on both list and edit page.

## Approver Name at Activity Timeline
When User sent Sales order for approval to a particular user then it should show the approver name to which the approval request has been sent to be shown at activity timeline.

## Sales Order Print Screen Enhancement

### Delivery/OC-level grouping
Need a Column name Sub Total(will have Sales Order Currency)
Value will have currency coming from Deliveries.
Sub Total Calculation = Value($)
67,200 = $ 800, when 1 USD ($) = 84 INR.
1.98 = VDN 600, When 1INR = 300 VDN.

### Quantity visibility
When user put on the Extra production % at article header inside delivery of a sales order.
Display the quantity, including the extra production %, in a separate grid in Performa invoice and Print page.
We have added under each Delivery OC card, directly beneath the 'Quantity Breakup' matrix, an 'Extra Production %' grid.
Sales Order Print Screen Link- https://sales-order-sprint-3-screendesign-1.vercel.app/PrintView%202.html
